aml_matched_comparison.caveat: Matched benchmark comparison only. Missing positive slices remain unassessed; no claim about real-world crime accuracy or approval follows.

review_status.caveat: Reviewer agreement concerns visible anomalies, not verified fraud, money laundering, or production accuracy. Unreviewed and insufficient-evidence cases are unresolved, never normal labels. This validation population has already been used in research; it is not a new final holdout.

AML.uncertainty: The conservative interval uses stratum-wise Hoeffding bounds with Bonferroni correction for 95% sampling coverage and remains nondegenerate for zero observed anomalies. Approximate normal design interval assumes fixed reviewer judgements and stratified SRS; it excludes reviewer error and source-population transfer. With unresolved flagged reviews no population point estimate is reported; sample-weighted missing-review bounds are not a population confidence interval.

FRAUD.uncertainty: The conservative interval uses stratum-wise Hoeffding bounds with Bonferroni correction for 95% sampling coverage and remains nondegenerate for zero observed anomalies. Approximate normal design interval assumes fixed reviewer judgements and stratified SRS; it excludes reviewer error and source-population transfer. With unresolved flagged reviews no population point estimate is reported; sample-weighted missing-review bounds are not a population confidence interval.

limitations: Previously inspected published AMLSim simulation; SAR indicators are simulator labels, not verified financial crime.
Full-edge chronological evaluation primarily measures future behavior of known accounts, not unseen-account generalization.
The external archive has no separately stated data licence; the reference repository is Apache-2.0, which does not establish archive licensing.
Account-window scores are available only at window end; endpoint transaction support is not real-time detection.
Complete patterns and observed boundary fragments have separate denominators; a detected fragment is not complete-pattern recall.
Three models fit without labels; validation-based threshold/model selection is label-informed and explicitly not unsupervised evaluation.

protocol.currency: source units unknown; no conversion or USD/EUR assumption
protocol.label_provenance: Supplied Class fraud labels for real anonymized European-card transactions; not FCIP reviewer decisions or synthetic injections. Independent adjudication is unavailable.
protocol.licence_limitation: OpenML says Public; exact reusable licence is not established. Raw data stays ignored and is not redistributed.
limitations: Public historical benchmark, not unseen production data or fraud-probability calibration.
No account identity: customer-disjoint splitting and behavioural history are impossible.
PCA was supplied upstream; its fit population/time scope is unknown and cannot be reconstructed.
Only two days of relative time; no long-term drift or AML-network claim.

partition.clock: elapsed seconds since first observation; absolute date/timezone unknown

protocol.peer_fit: TRAIN-only robust median/IQR scaling of opaque PCA components; MiniBatchKMeans16, n_init5, batch2048, max_iter100; fixed seed. No customer identity claim.
protocol.selection: precision with TP>=reference in all/small/three relative-time blocks, FP<=reference; fallback allowed
